title: incident-bot: orchestrated oncall diagnostics + SLO toolkit integration
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: on-call engineers frequently need curated diagnostics and runbooks surfaced at incident start; current incident-bot responses surface links but lack orchestration between SLO toolkit heuristics and runbook execution steps. This PR implements an orchestration layer that coordinates the SLO toolkit's priority signals with incident-bot's runbook suggestions and automated diagnostics chain. The goal is to reduce time-to-detect root causes and to provide deterministic next actions (checks + remediation hints) for on-call. Changes include: 1) new orchestration handler that composes SLO hint outputs with runbook steps and automated diagnostics tasks; 2) lightweight state machine to track diagnostics progress for a given oncall session (queued -> running -> reported -> actioned); 3) enhancements to the compact runbook format to include priority metadata and diagnostic probes; 4) telemetry hooks and span instrumentation for tracing orchestration decisions; 5) migration of existing runbook-linking heuristics into the SLO toolkit helpers module to remove duplication. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for orchestration handler - [x] Integration tests for diagnostics chain (local docker-compose harness) - [x] Backwards-compatible schema changes for runbook metadata - [x] End-to-end smoke test with incident replay harness - [x] Docs updated (runbook authoring + oncall playbook) Testing notes: ran full test matrix in CI (lint, unit, integration) and validated with oncall simulation; load-tested orchestration paths under 50 concurrent incidents to ensure queueing behaviour and KV-store TTLs are sane. Related work: ENG-2345 (oncall tooling epic), SRE-412 (SLO toolkit priority signals), SUP-9812 (customer-reported runbook churn during incidents).
